mapper.select: SELECT a.*,p.nickname professorName FROM professor_appointment a JOIN sys_user p ON p.id=a.professor_id WHERE a.user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY a.created_at DESC
SELECT a.*,u.nickname studentName FROM professor_appointment a JOIN sys_user u ON u.id=a.user_id WHERE a.professor_id=#{professorId} ORDER BY a.created_at DESC
SELECT a.*,u.nickname studentName,p.nickname professorName FROM professor_appointment a JOIN sys_user u ON u.id=a.user_id JOIN sys_user p ON p.id=a.professor_id ORDER BY a.created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO professor_appointment(appointment_no,user_id,professor_id,consultation_type,subject,content,appointment_time,status) SELECT #{appointmentNo},#{userId},u.id,#{type},#{subject},#{content},#{time},'待确认' FROM sys_user u JOIN professor_profile p ON p.user_id=u.id WHERE u.id=#{professorId} AND u.role='PROFESSOR' AND u.status='正常' AND p.audit_status='已通过'
mapper.select: SELECT id,user_id userId,professor_id professorId,status FROM professor_appointment WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE professor_appointment SET status=#{status},professor_reply=#{reply},updated_at=NOW() WHERE id=#{id} AND status='待确认' AND user_id=#{ownerId}AND professor_id=#{ownerId}
